blocks.text: NVIDIA is optional and selected by the installation profile/add-on policy. Driver branch, firmware and kernel-module requirements are managed by the installer. The presence of support files does not prove a module loaded or a monitor is attached to that GPU.

Inspect the display controller and its 'Kernel driver in use' line locally. The output can reveal hardware identifiers; redact them before sharing. Check the selected host profile and boot logs if the intended driver is unavailable.

Do not replace the managed driver branch with arbitrary vendor installers, rebuild drivers from source, or remove module-signature policy to bypass a failure. Driver changes and reboot recovery require an administrator and a known working recovery path.
